2026-09-22: Discovered a real latent bug while re-doing the timeAgo test PR: package.json's test script `node --test app/**/*.test.js` (unquoted) only worked by accident. Bash without globstar treats `**` as a single `*` (can't cross `/`); since no file used to match the resulting one-level pattern app/*/*.test.js, bash left the glob unexpanded and Node's own recursive matcher ran it correctly. Adding app/utils/timeAgo.test.js (exactly one level deep) made bash match and pass only that literal filename to Node, silently dropping the two existing app/api/**/*.test.js suites while npm test kept reporting green. Fixed by quoting the glob: `node --test 'app/**/*.test.js'`. Worth double-checking in a future run that this quoting survives merge (in case #7's PR is edited/rebased).
